translation.title: Salicylic Acid Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for corns, calluses, and warts.
translation.usage: Attach the medicated pad in the centre onto the affected area and fix it so that it does not move.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have diabetes or a blood circulation disorder, or on the area around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on infected, inflamed, reddened, or irritated areas, on moles, on moles or warts present since birth, on hairy warts, or on warts in the genital area. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, if the user is an infant or young child, if you are hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics, or if you have kidney failure, purulent dermatitis, moist skin, or eroded skin. Follow the prescribed directions and dosage. When it is used for a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Take care when going into water with the patch attached, as the medicated mass may dissolve away. Use this medicine externally only. Apply it carefully so that it does not come into contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or other mucous membranes, and if it gets into the eyes, rinse them out completely with plenty of water. Take care that it does not come into contact with skin other than the affected area. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you use it together with methotrexate, a sulfonylurea, or another medicine applied to the skin. Rash, redness, erythema, itching, or a local irritant reaction where it has touched normal skin may occur. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Skin irritation or a contact allergic reaction may occur rarely. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
